reading: Sunrise on the Reaping places Joseph Zada, Mckenna Grace and Whitney Peak at the centre of the latest Hunger Games instalment.
Set 24 years before the original film, it adapts Suzanne Collins’ 2025 novel of the same name.
The sixth film joins a series whose worldwide earnings have exceeded $3.3 billion since 2012.
Beginning a gruelling press run, the trio showed a mixture of anticipation, anxiety and excitement surrounding the release.
Grace brings substantial screen experience, including appearances in The Handmaid’s Tale and two recent Ghostbusters films.
Nevertheless, she described joining the franchise as deeply unsettling and unlike anything her previous work had prepared her for.
Peak joked that she and Zada repeatedly sought out Grace when they felt stuck or confused while promoting the film, while Zada described her as a mentor.
Zada plays the teenage Haymitch, a District 12 participant portrayed by Woody Harrelson in the original films.
Reviews have been generally positive, with several outlets praising Zada while acknowledging the difficulty of stepping into Harrelson's shoes.
Having spent months studying Harrelson’s earlier portrayals, Zada used his research as a foundation for his own interpretation.
When they met halfway through filming, Harrelson recommended Cool Hand Luke, which Zada said helped ground his portrayal, and Harold and Maud, which he described as an enjoyable watch.
Jesse Plemons regarded Zada’s role as a substantial undertaking and expressed admiration for his stamina and composure.
An ensemble cast including Ralph Fiennes, Maya Hawke, Kieran Culkin and Elle Fanning returns audiences to a brutal dystopian world during the fiftieth Hunger Games.
Within that fictional society, the ruling Capitol organises annual games involving Panem’s twelve districts as punishment for rebellion.
Peak described the work as intensely stressful at times, making lighter moments between difficult scenes particularly valuable.
Grace linked the cast’s close bonds to the days they spent sharing physically strenuous and emotionally intense work.

vocabulary.definition: Requiring prolonged, exhausting physical or mental effort.
An expectant feeling about an approaching event, often involving excitement or uncertainty.
Deliberately approached a particular person to obtain help, advice or reassurance.
Taking over a role associated with Harrelson, with the expectations that come from succeeding an established actor.
An actor’s particular understanding and presentation of a role through creative choices.
To give an artistic portrayal a convincing basis that makes it feel believable.
A substantial task or responsibility requiring considerable effort and commitment.
The capacity to sustain physical or mental effort over an extended period.
A group of actors whose collective participation is a significant feature of a production.
Depicting an imagined society characterised by oppression, suffering or severely restricted freedom.

entries.ja: 心身をひどく消耗させるような、長時間にわたる身体的または精神的な努力を必要とする。
entries.ko: 오랜 시간에 걸쳐 몸이나 마음을 몹시 지치게 하는 노력을 요구하는.
entries.zh-Hans: 需要长时间付出令人筋疲力尽的体力或脑力劳动的。
entries.es: Que exige un esfuerzo físico o mental prolongado y agotador.
entries.pt-BR: Que exige esforço físico ou mental prolongado e exaustivo.
entries.fr: Qui exige un effort physique ou mental prolongé et épuisant.
entries.de: Erfordert lang anhaltende, erschöpfende körperliche oder geistige Anstrengung.

entries.ja: 近づいている出来事を待ち受ける気持ちで、しばしばわくわくする気持ちや、どうなるか分からない不確かさを伴う。
entries.ko: 다가오는 일에 대한 기대감으로, 흔히 설렘이나 불확실함을 동반하는 감정.
entries.zh-Hans: 等待即将发生的事情时产生的期待感，常伴有兴奋或不确定的心情。
entries.es: Sensación de espera ante un acontecimiento próximo, a menudo acompañada de entusiasmo o incertidumbre.
entries.pt-BR: Sentimento de expectativa diante de um acontecimento próximo, muitas vezes acompanhado de empolgação ou incerteza.
entries.fr: Sentiment d’attente à l’approche d’un événement, souvent accompagné d’enthousiasme ou d’incertitude.
entries.de: Ein Gefühl der Erwartung angesichts eines bevorstehenden Ereignisses, oft verbunden mit Aufregung oder Ungewissheit.

entries.ja: 助けや助言を得たり、安心させてもらったりするために、特定の人に意図的に会いに行ったり、声をかけたりした。
entries.ko: 도움이나 조언을 얻거나 안심하기 위해 특정한 사람을 일부러 찾아갔다.
entries.zh-Hans: 为了获得帮助、建议或宽慰，特意去找了某个人。
entries.es: Acudieron deliberadamente a una persona concreta para obtener ayuda, consejo o tranquilidad.
entries.pt-BR: Procuraram uma pessoa específica de propósito para obter ajuda, orientação ou uma palavra de conforto.
entries.fr: Ont délibérément sollicité une personne précise pour obtenir de l’aide, des conseils ou du réconfort.
entries.de: Suchten gezielt eine bestimmte Person auf, um Hilfe, Rat oder Zuspruch zu erhalten.

entries.ja: ハレルソンと結びつけられている役を引き継ぎ、実績のある俳優の後を継ぐことで生じる期待を背負うこと。
entries.ko: 해럴슨과 연결되어 있는 배역을 이어받으며, 이미 인정받은 배우의 뒤를 잇는 데 따르는 기대를 감당하는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 接演一个与哈里森紧密联系的角色，并面对接替一位已获认可的演员所带来的期待。
entries.es: Asumir un papel asociado con Harrelson, con las expectativas que conlleva suceder a un actor consolidado.
entries.pt-BR: Assumir um papel associado a Harrelson, com as expectativas que surgem ao suceder um ator consagrado.
entries.fr: Reprendre un rôle associé à Harrelson, avec les attentes que suscite le fait de succéder à un acteur reconnu.
entries.de: Eine mit Harrelson verbundene Rolle übernehmen und dabei die Erwartungen erfüllen sollen, die mit der Nachfolge eines etablierten Schauspielers einhergehen.

entries.ja: 俳優が創作上の選択を通じて示す、その役についての独自の理解と表現。
entries.ko: 배우가 창의적인 선택을 통해 보여 주는 배역에 대한 자신만의 이해와 표현.
entries.zh-Hans: 演员通过创作上的选择，对角色形成的独特理解及其呈现方式。
entries.es: La manera particular en que un actor comprende y presenta un papel mediante sus decisiones creativas.
entries.pt-BR: A maneira particular como um ator compreende e apresenta um papel por meio de suas escolhas criativas.
entries.fr: La manière particulière dont un acteur comprend et présente un rôle à travers ses choix créatifs.
entries.de: Die persönliche Auffassung einer Rolle durch einen Schauspieler und die Art, wie er sie durch kreative Entscheidungen darstellt.

entries.ja: 芸術的な描写や演技に説得力のある土台を与え、見る人が信じられるようにすること。
entries.ko: 예술적 묘사나 연기에 설득력 있는 바탕을 부여하여 믿을 만하게 느껴지도록 하다.
entries.zh-Hans: 为艺术描绘或表演提供有说服力的基础，使其显得可信。
entries.es: Dar a una representación artística una base convincente que la haga creíble.
entries.pt-BR: Dar a uma representação artística uma base convincente que a faça parecer verossímil.
entries.fr: Donner à une représentation artistique une base convaincante qui la rende crédible.
entries.de: Einer künstlerischen Darstellung eine überzeugende Grundlage geben, durch die sie glaubhaft wirkt.

entries.ja: 多大な努力と真剣な取り組みを必要とする、大きな仕事や責任。
entries.ko: 상당한 노력과 헌신이 필요한 큰 과제나 책임.
entries.zh-Hans: 需要付出相当多的努力和投入的重大任务或责任。
entries.es: Una tarea o responsabilidad importante que exige un esfuerzo y una dedicación considerables.
entries.pt-BR: Uma tarefa ou responsabilidade importante que exige esforço e dedicação consideráveis.
entries.fr: Une tâche ou une responsabilité importante qui exige des efforts et un engagement considérables.
entries.de: Eine umfangreiche Aufgabe oder große Verantwortung, die erhebliche Anstrengung und Einsatz erfordert.

entries.ja: 身体的または精神的な努力を長時間にわたって続けられる能力。
entries.ko: 신체적 또는 정신적 노력을 오랜 시간 지속할 수 있는 능력.
entries.zh-Hans: 长时间持续付出体力或脑力的能力。
entries.es: La capacidad de mantener un esfuerzo físico o mental durante un período prolongado.
entries.pt-BR: A capacidade de manter um esforço físico ou mental por um período prolongado.
entries.fr: La capacité à maintenir un effort physique ou mental pendant une longue période.
entries.de: Die Fähigkeit, körperliche oder geistige Anstrengung über einen längeren Zeitraum aufrechtzuerhalten.

entries.ja: 俳優たちが共に出演することが、作品の重要な特徴となっている出演者の集まり。
entries.ko: 배우들이 함께 참여한다는 점이 작품의 중요한 특징을 이루는 출연진.
entries.zh-Hans: 一群共同参演的演员，他们的集体参与是作品的一项重要特色。
entries.es: Un grupo de actores cuya participación conjunta es una característica destacada de una producción.
entries.pt-BR: Um grupo de atores cuja participação conjunta é uma característica importante de uma produção.
entries.fr: Un groupe d’acteurs dont la participation collective constitue une caractéristique importante d’une production.
entries.de: Eine Gruppe von Schauspielern, deren gemeinsames Mitwirken ein wesentliches Merkmal einer Produktion ist.

entries.ja: 抑圧や苦しみ、または自由の厳しい制限を特徴とする架空の社会を描いている。
entries.ko: 억압, 고통 또는 심각하게 제한된 자유를 특징으로 하는 가상의 사회를 묘사하는.
entries.zh-Hans: 描绘一个以压迫、苦难或自由受到严重限制为特征的虚构社会的。
entries.es: Que representa una sociedad imaginaria caracterizada por la opresión, el sufrimiento o una libertad muy restringida.
entries.pt-BR: Que retrata uma sociedade imaginária caracterizada pela opressão, pelo sofrimento ou pela liberdade severamente limitada.
entries.fr: Qui dépeint une société imaginaire caractérisée par l’oppression, la souffrance ou une liberté fortement restreinte.
entries.de: Beschreibt eine erfundene Gesellschaft, die von Unterdrückung, Leid oder stark eingeschränkter Freiheit geprägt ist.
